text_block_list.text: (――*THUD!!* *BAM!!* *THUD!!*)

As I was walking down the hallway,
a tremendous crashing sound suddenly echoed out...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hahaha!! Hahahaha!!
AHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Behold...!! The visage of my soul!!
Hearken...!! To the lament of my flesh!!!!
Before a cackling Tanino Gimlet lay a mountain of cardboard boxes――and every single one of them had been smashed to pieces...!!!!
Whooooaa!! AWESOOOME!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Did you do all of this by yourself, Senpai!?
It's totally flattened into pancakes, whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... I simply followed my own principles, and this was the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――So, did you find the item in question?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yes ma'am! I borrowed some vinyl string!
Let's wrap this cleanup right up!

After that, the two of them diligently began tying up
the destroyed cardboard boxes with string.
...I see, they're preparing them for recycling.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What is it? What are you staring at? Do you seek destruction as well?
choice_data_list: No…… I was just thinking you're cleaning it up all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Naturally. Destruction always walks hand in hand with rebirth.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So tell me—
Do you yearn for rebirth?
Or do you wish to surrender yourself to the ecstasy of destruction?
Does she mean we should bundle the cardboard boxes, or flatten them completely...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
If so, bind that chaos with the threads of pure reason.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could it be... that I should just
tie up the cardboard boxes with string?!
The three of us tied up the cardboard boxes into neat bundles, and in no time at all, the area was tidied up as if nothing had ever happened.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph... With this, chaos meets its end, and the world becomes a realm governed by order.
I still couldn't make heads or tails of what Tanino Gimlet was saying... but thanks to everything being neatly tidied up, my mind was finally at peace.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
Fortunately, the offerings still remain.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too! Please let me try it too!
Alright, you! It's on!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Cast off your shackles—!!
Forsake everything and surrender yourself to chaos!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I can see your potential.
...The day you break free from mere concepts is drawing near.
